sloka: ततो हरिगणान् भग्नान् दृष्ट्वा वालिसुतस्तदा ।क्रोधेन वज्रदंष्ट्रं तमुदीक्षन्तमुदैक्षत ।। ६.५४.१७ ।।।।
transliteration: tato harigaṇān bhagnān dṛṣṭvā vālisutastadā ।krodhena vajradaṁṣṭraṁ tamudīkṣantamudaikṣata ।। 6.54.17 ।।।।

translations.english: Vajradamshtra and Angada both enraged and strode among Rakshasas and monkeys and fought like a lion and intoxicated elephant.
